refresh.overlapCheckFailed: Couldn’t check “{{field}}” for overlaps — append will still add all rows.

refresh.periodColumnLabel: Date column that defines the period

refresh.periodBlockedTitle: Pick a date column to replace a period
refresh.confirmPeriodBody: The period is the earliest to the latest “{{field}}” in the new file(s), inclusive. Every row of the dataset inside it is removed — even one the new file no longer has — and the new rows are added. Rows outside it, or with no “{{field}}”, are kept. Every new row must have a “{{field}}”.
